stories.title: Indian Startup Funding Surges 826% to $290 Mn as 23 Startups Raise Capital This Week - TechStory
Indian startup funding rebounds to $62.4 million
stories.summary: Indian startup funding reached $62.4 million between November 13 and 19, a 515% increase from the previous week according to the Sahyadri Startups tracker. Humyn Labs and Bharat Semi accounted for $50 million of the total. The ecosystem is currently relying on a narrow concentration of capital.

stories.title: VC funding in India rises after record low
stories.summary: Venture capital funding in Indian startups reached $255 million across 22 deals for the third week of November. This follows a record low of $26 million the previous week, which was attributed to festival holidays. The ecosystem is describing the recovery as a welcome sign.

stories.title: Indian startups raise $291 million in one week
stories.summary: Indian startups raised $291.3 million between November 16 and 20, a 1,056% increase from the $25.2 million reported the week prior. The deal count rose to 22, up from nine. The surge was led by large investments in Dreamteam, Style Union and Humyn Labs.

stories.title: Legend of Toys secures Rs 21 crore
stories.summary: Toy startup Legend of Toys has raised Rs 21 crore in a pre-Series A round to expand its product portfolio and international reach. The company, which focuses on remote-controlled vehicles, reported an annual recurring revenue of Rs 30 crore. It plans to use the capital for marketing.

stories.title: Matters.AI to raise Rs 110 crore
stories.summary: Data security startup Matters.AI is raising Rs 110 crore in a pre-Series A round led by Tanglin Ventures. The company will issue shares at Rs 28,460 each. Existing investors including Kalari Capital and Endiya Ventures are participating in the round alongside the lead investor.

stories.title: VitusCare raises $3 million for dialysis network
stories.summary: Dialysis provider VitusCare has raised $3 million in a Series B round led by Liberty Ridge Capital, HDFC Bank, Equentis and NAFA Capital Advisors. The company plans to use the funds to increase its center network and train staff. It previously raised $2.7 million in 2024.

stories.title: NEPRA raises Rs 110 crore from PIDG
stories.summary: Ahmedabad-based waste management firm NEPRA has raised Rs 110 crore in equity from the Private Infrastructure Development Group. This marks the investor's first waste-sector bet in Asia. The company plans to use the capital to build new material recovery facilities and expand its plastic recycling capacity.

stories.title: InPrime Finserv raises Rs 101 crore
stories.summary: NBFC InPrime Finserv has raised Rs 101 crore in a Series B round led by FMO. The company lends to small business owners in the informal economy and plans to use the funding to diversify into micro-mortgages. This round brings the company's total funding to Rs 190 crore.

stories.title: European tech weekly recap: More than 65 tech funding deals worth over €6B - Tech.eu
Exclusive | Genesis AI, a Robotics Startup, Raises $500 Million - WSJ
Genesis AI raises $500 million at $3.5 billion valuation
stories.summary: Genesis AI has raised $500 million in Series A funding at a $3.5 billion valuation. The company is developing a robot named Eno, which features a rotating wheeled base and no head. The firm is currently prioritizing the U.S. market for its supply chain and customer trials.

stories.title: Neurotech leads weekly U.S. funding rounds
stories.summary: U.S. startups continued to secure large funding rounds this week, headlined by a $400 million deal for a neurotech firm. While private markets remain active, the broader tech sector is facing downward pressure from recent stock market volatility. The industry is watching for potential spillover effects.

stories.title: Science Corporation raises $400 million Series D
stories.summary: Brain-computer interface startup Science Corporation has raised $400 million in a Series D round. The company has raised over $900 million since 2021. While some reports suggest a $3.5 billion valuation, the company has not confirmed the figure. It plans to use the capital for its implant.

stories.title: Corma reaches $1 billion valuation
stories.summary: Cybersecurity AI lab Corma has raised $125 million in Series A funding at a $1 billion valuation. The round was led by NEA just three months after the company's seed round. The firm claims its models are seeing increased adoption among Fortune 500 companies.

stories.title: Egypt's Connect Money Raises USD 3.5 M To Expand Into Saudi Arabia & Morocco - WeeTracker
Africa and Middle East funding hits $169.5 million
stories.summary: Startups in Africa, the Middle East and Israel raised $169.5 million this week, down from $258.6 million the previous week. The total was heavily influenced by Corma's $125 million Series A, which accounted for approximately 74% of the regional funding volume.

stories.title: Elysian Aircraft raises €12 million
stories.summary: Dutch electric aircraft developer Elysian Aircraft has closed a €12 million pre-Series A round backed by FideFlux, SecFund and ROM InWest. The company intends to use the funds to develop aerospace electrification technologies. It has also signaled plans for a Series A round in 2027.

stories.title: India AI funding doubles as capital concentrates in fewer deals
stories.summary: Indian AI startups raised $1.6 billion in the first nine months of 2026, a 96% increase from the previous year. Despite the surge, the total number of deals declined. Most capital flowed into a handful of large funding rounds, leaving a smaller pool of companies attracting investment.

stories.title: Telangana tech funding surge masks narrowing startup field
stories.summary: Telangana recorded $726 million in tech funding during the first nine months of 2026, a 266% increase. However, the state also saw a 30% decline in funding rounds and a 31% drop in newly funded companies. The ecosystem is increasingly concentrated among a few select businesses.

stories.title: Telangana tech funding jumps 266% despite fewer deals
stories.summary: Telangana startups raised $726 million in the first nine months of 2026, up from $199 million in the same period last year. The number of funding rounds fell by 30% to 73. Capital is increasingly concentrated in large rounds, led by data centre operator CtrlS.

stories.title: Oister Global launches $64.5M deeptech growth fund for India - Dealroom
Alkemi Growth Capital eyes $150 million third fund
stories.summary: Healthcare-focused venture firm Alkemi Growth Capital plans to launch its third fund between March and June 2027. The firm aims to raise $125-150 million to expand its investments in preventive medicine, medical deep-tech, and healthcare innovation.

stories.title: CTech launches VC survey to track AI investment shifts
stories.summary: CTech is conducting its annual VC Survey 2027, gathering insights from over 100 venture capital executives. The project aims to document how the AI revolution is altering investment strategies, liquidity challenges, and the broader position of the Israeli market in the global tech ecosystem.

stories.title: Carta data shows record cash with fewer startup deals
stories.summary: Startups on Carta raised $100 billion over the last two quarters, the highest amount since early 2022. While median valuations rose and dilution fell, total deal counts dropped 21% year over year. Companies that do manage to raise are currently securing the best terms of the decade.

stories.title: Nicole DeTommaso: Venture capital and private equity firms pursue different business models - Traders Union
European angel investors cash in on Anthropic
stories.summary: A group of European angel investors who backed Anthropic via an invite-only platform are set to see returns following the company's IPO. The investors gained exposure to the US-based AI lab in recent years, participating in funding rounds that preceded the company's public debut.

stories.title: Anthropic IPO raises $81.3 billion in record debut
stories.summary: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share, raising $81.3 billion in the largest initial public offering on record. The company's debut coincided with a week of significant activity in AI drug design and compute infrastructure, alongside Nvidia reporting $115.8 billion in third-quarter revenue.

stories.title: Anthropic debut tests venture capital valuation models
stories.summary: Anthropic began trading on the Nasdaq at a $1.5 trillion valuation, forcing investors to adjust to higher entry prices. The stock closed its first day at $97.17, up 17% from its IPO price. The company's market value reached $1.3 trillion based on outstanding shares.

stories.title: Anthropic and SpaceX IPOs strain banker relations
stories.summary: Anthropic and SpaceX have conducted unusual IPO processes that reportedly frustrated Wall Street underwriters. Bankers and lawyers involved in the deals faced strict non-compete requirements and limited team sizes, leading to private complaints about the complexity and unconventional nature of the proceedings.

stories.title: Anthropic IPO process draws banker complaints
stories.summary: Anthropic reportedly limited its IPO underwriters to four bankers per deal team and requested six-month non-compete agreements covering rival firms. Bankers were also given limited time to approve last-minute filings. The process was described as unlike any they had worked on before.

stories.title: Anthropic shares drop after record IPO
stories.summary: Anthropic shares fell over 11% on Friday, dropping to a low of $86 after closing their first day of trading at $97.17. The decline erased nearly all gains made since the company's public debut, which had been the largest IPO on record.

stories.title: NLC India Renewables files for IPO
stories.summary: NLC India Renewables has filed draft papers for an initial public offering to raise INR 33 billion. The company plans to use the proceeds for debt repayment. The offering also includes an offer for sale of 100 million shares by its parent company.

stories.title: Fintech stocks slide as UPI fee rollout stalls
stories.summary: Investors in India's digital payment sector have seen shares of Paytm, Pine Labs, and MobiKwik correct following delays to the merchant discount rate rollout. The expected revenue stream from UPI transactions remains uncertain, cooling the optimism that previously supported fintech valuations.

stories.title: Indian tech startups eye public listings
stories.summary: Indian startups are increasingly pursuing public listings as a sign of maturity and a pathway for investor exits. Companies including Razorpay, PRISM, and PhonePe are currently in various stages of the IPO process, marking a shift toward long-term viability and operational transparency.

stories.title: GG Technologies sues Apple in India over patent infringement
stories.summary: GG Technologies has filed a lawsuit in the Bombay High Court against Apple, seeking 15 billion rupees in damages. The startup claims Apple's NameDrop feature infringes on its own contact-sharing technology, StayTouch. The company is asking for an order to restrict the sale of iPhones and Apple Watches.

stories.title: IIT Delhi alumnus sues Apple for 1,500 crore rupees
stories.summary: GG Technologies has sued Apple in the Bombay High Court, alleging the iPhone maker copied its patented contact-sharing technology for the NameDrop feature. The startup, founded by IIT Delhi alumnus Gaurav Goel, is seeking 1,500 crore rupees in damages. The court will now decide on the claim.

stories.title: Sridhar Vembu compares AI impact to mechanisation
stories.summary: Zoho co-founder Sridhar Vembu suggests AI will transform intellectual work just as mechanisation once changed traditional trades. He argues that mathematicians and programmers now face the same displacement that farmers and weavers experienced during earlier technological shifts. The nature of skilled professional work is being redefined.

stories.title: Elon Musk warns of AI industry cash crunch in 2027
stories.summary: Elon Musk has warned that the AI industry may face a severe cash crunch in 2027 due to the high cost of data centres and computing infrastructure. He noted that delays between paying for hardware and generating revenue could leave companies needing hundreds of billions in additional working capital.

stories.title: Anthropic CEO prioritises culture over technical talent
stories.summary: Ahead of a 1.4 trillion dollar IPO, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei told Jamie Dimon that the company prioritises culture over raw technical ability. Amodei stated that he and his co-founders agreed to this hiring philosophy on day one, even if it means turning away brilliant engineers.

stories.title: Corover to build agentic AI for government ministries
stories.summary: The Ministry of Electronics and IT has selected six-person startup Corover to build its first agentic AI project. Founder Ankush Sabharwal stated that when working on government contracts, the goal is to deliver within defined timelines rather than to invent. The project is currently underway.

stories.title: Experts warn of honey-trap risks for AI founders
stories.summary: Former CIA officer Aaron Brown warns that AI founders are increasingly susceptible to honey-trap schemes as valuable industry secrets move into private companies. Brown noted that while such tactics previously targeted politicians and the military, many founders currently lack training in counterintelligence to protect their infrastructure and models.

stories.title: Signal restricts screenshots to block AI agents
stories.summary: Signal is restricting screenshots to prevent AI agents from reading private messages on user devices. The company warned that the industry's push to embed AI is eroding privacy, and it has called on Apple, Google, and Microsoft to provide developers with better tools to block data access.

stories.title: Apple plans autonomous AI agent to control devices
stories.summary: Apple is developing an autonomous AI agent capable of writing code, browsing the web, and controlling apps on behalf of users. Job listings confirm the company intends to compete with OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta in the agentic AI market. The system is designed to be proactive.
